translationRules.translatesNeverRedefines: An adapter maps framework behavior onto a native surface. It never changes what a control means, only how it is expressed.
translationRules.noAuthorityOrigination: An adapter never becomes an authority. It cannot approve, cannot classify risk, and cannot resolve a source conflict.
translationRules.noProjectGovernance: An adapter carries no project-specific governance. Project rules live in the Profile, not the adapter.
translationRules.noStateInvention: An adapter may not invent, rename, merge, skip, or reorder a governed lifecycle state or gate.
translationRules.noIndependenceCollapse: An adapter may not collapse required independent steps into one invocation for convenience.

capabilityMap.translationNote: Claude turns map to work on a governed work item; the item holds state, not the conversation
In-container Python/bash runs framework deterministic checks reproducibly — the strongest independence mechanism available here
Files written to outputs and downloaded by owner are the durable state layer
Finite context; continuity snapshots with hash-chained packages carry state across sessions and platforms
sha256sum/hashlib available; used for package chain and freeze attestation

PROTOCOL: open a NEW conversation; supply governing sources + work product + acceptance criteria + evidence, but NOT the originating instance's reasoning or scratch context; require the reviewer to reconstruct conclusions independently; record all 11 independence evidence fields
capabilityMap.mitigation: This is the discipline that makes independence real on a single-platform. It is a manual protocol the owner initiates; the adapter defines it, the owner executes it.

capabilityMap.translationNote: Where subagents exist they are correlated reviewers unless given clean context; a subagent in the same reasoning lineage does NOT satisfy independence
git available in-container; repo exported before session end
Different Claude tiers available; a genuinely different model family is not, without the owner running it elsewhere
capabilityMap.mitigation: Gates specifically requiring cross-family independence route to HUMAN_REVIEW or a different platform. Never simulated.
Delegate to GitHub adapter; live validation deferred to owner

capabilityMap.translationNote: secret_protection non-waivable; no vault; chat is plaintext
capabilityMap.mitigation: Secrets never entered in conversation; bound in owner's environment via unbound interface
Durable externalized state: complete self-contained continuation package + SHA256SUMS exported each run, re-uploaded and validated on resume, chained by predecessor hash. Owner retains packages.
Tool-permission matrix declarative; enforced via GitHub/CI adapter

prohibitions: MUST NOT encode platform conveniences as framework behavior
MUST NOT contain any project-specific governance (portability requirement)
Conversation memory is never durable state
A relabeled same-context review never satisfies independence
MUST NOT self-certify a control it cannot actually satisfy — declares CANNOT_SATISFY honestly

evidenceTranslation.rule: Evidence is produced by reproducible in-container scripts and exported with content hashes. Model assertion is never evidence. Every reproducible evidence record carries its reproduction command.

evidenceSurfaceMap.anthropicSurface: clean-context separate conversation with 11 evidence fields

handoffTranslation.rule: Handoff = exported continuation package (artifacts + snapshot + evidence + SHA256SUMS). Successor validates Core hash, package integrity, and predecessor-chain before any work; a break is a STOP condition.

lifecycleSyncRule: The conversation reflects the canonical work-item state; Claude never holds a competing state, and a new session reconstructs state from the continuation package, never from memory.
